From the jungles of Cambodia to the deserts of Peru, Josh Gates takes on some of history's most intriguing mysteries. He searches for lost treasures, investigates ancient legends and follows clues that lead to forgotten worlds. Whether tracking down a legendary pirate's gold, exploring the secrets of the Vikings or chasing the truth behind an iconic disappearance, every expedition brings a new challenge. How far will Josh go to uncover the impossible?
Watch Expedition Unknown, Season 1, Episodes 7, 1, 6, 12, 4, 2, 10 and 3, on Discovery Channel India.
